purpose: Prove that Mechanicus has its own script-first validator coverage for identity, functions, capability evidence, tool admission, build/evidence lanes and claim discipline without claiming full organ assembly.
rules: Personal validators must exist as files under ORGANS/MECHANICUS/VALIDATORS and must be script-first Python validators.
Required personal validators must have no control characters and must compile with Python py_compile.
The personal validator registry must map each validator to the Mechanicus gate/function it protects.
At least one validator must protect claim discipline and must forbid MECHANICUS_ASSEMBLED or SIX_GATES_100_PERCENT_CLOSED claims before external gates close.
This gate may set G4 to PASS_BASELINE only; it must not claim Custodes or Throne acceptance.
Local model membrane remains DEFERRED_AFTER_CORE_V1 and cannot be a validator.
pass_meaning: Mechanicus has baseline personal validator coverage and its required validators are present, syntax-valid and bound to gates/functions.
pass_does_not_mean: Local model membrane exists or can validate anything
